roadmap.scope: SLICE 1: claim_domain::identity_link core, identity link/verify/list/forget, v7 checks + read/write/purge ports, GithubPort::read_person_by_id + DD-GDL-11 contract test, reserved-predicate guard (claim counter exempt, D-b), GDL-D13 check-arch rules. SLICE 2 (phase 02): readers — identity list lineage, age hint, record IDs and --did; scorer drops sameAs; infer people and person-scrape link lines (scrape refreshes checks); search label; ADR-084 peer-pull fixture.

conventions.paradigm: ADR-007: decisions pure in claim-domain; adapters and cli verbs do I/O only.
conventions.test_paradigm: Acceptance: example-based subprocess. Pure core: proptest against the CORE oracles. Adapters: real DuckDB / real HTTP adapter against FakeGithubAccounts, never mocked.
conventions.scenario_fns: `<cargo test target>::<fn>` (identity_link = tests/acceptance/identity_link.rs, identity_link_core = tests/acceptance/identity_link_core.rs), in activation order.
conventions.test_edit_allow_list: Test-file edits limited to: removing the #[ignore] of a named scenario_fn; replacing the named sut_* body with ONE real call plus view mapping (DD-GDL-16). Forbidden: assertions, oracles, strategies, universe slots, helpers, test names. The GREEN diff must match. Carve-out (U-12, review N3): crafter-owned tests in their owning crates (adapter contract tests such as crates/adapter-github/tests/github_profile_contract.rs, xtask check-arch rule tests, claim-domain unit/property tests) may be added; tests/acceptance stays under this allow-list.
conventions.test_runs: Scoped targets only, never the workspace. libtest runs tests matching ANY positional filter (library/test/src/cli.rs), so `-- f1 f2` is used.
conventions.check_arch: `cargo xtask check-arch` (.cargo/config.toml alias) + `cargo test -p xtask`; each new rule ships a synthetic-violation test.
conventions.link_predicate_api: Q-RM-5: claim_domain::identity_link exposes the link predicate through its API (e.g. link_predicate()); readers select candidate rows with it; project() decides.

steps.description: D-c / ADR-085 §8: search rows that are identity links carry the one label `authority not checked here`. Link rows are selected through the claim_domain::identity_link API, never the literal. The indexer is unchanged and gains no GitHub capability (C-GDL-8).
criteria: IR-16: `search --object github:priyaraman` lists Priya's link, attributed to her DID, with `authority not checked here`.
A non-link `github:` row carries no authority label (U-7, slice 2).
Existing search suites pass unchanged for rows that are not links.
steps.implementation_notes: Slice 2 closes all 19 IR-* plus CORE-6/6x; IR-19 is already active. U-7: label link rows only (selected with the identity_link API, Q-RM-5); widening to every `github:` row is a follow-up. Order: no code dependency on 02-01..02-07; kept last only so edits to identity_link_readers.rs stay serial.
